name: Kanban board
description: Draws a ```kanban block — a heading per column, a list item per card — as a board, and copies the board as a Markdown table. The note stays plain Markdown.
author: Lumen

capabilities.reason: Adds “New Kanban board” and “Copy Kanban board as a table”
Finds the board in the open note to export it
Inserts a new board at the cursor
Copies the board as a table
Tells you the board was copied, or that there is none
